about: The 76-question test plan on rstbasic, with the right answers written as SQL on the clean table (computed at run time). Types: count (number of elements or a COUNT), value (a number, 1% tolerance), labels (names that must appear; [a, b] = either), none (nothing found or said so), cant (says the data can't answer; no elements listed), clarify (asks back), manual (judged by a person). 'also' lists other accepted counts.
